reports.title: ZkSync snark-wrapper Security Review
reports.description: Spearbit review of the snark-wrapper constraints (with the Poseidon2 circuit gadgets in rescue-poseidon) that encode a Boojum STARK verifier inside the final PLONK compression SNARK, checked for faithful translation of the native era-boojum and rescue-poseidon verifier code. No translation errors were found; two Low issues concern public-input aggregation.

reports.title: zkSync Era Security Audit: Bug Fixes Review
reports.description: ChainLight review of recently reported soundness bugs and their fixes in the zkSync Era Boojum circuits and crypto libraries (SHA256, UInt32/UInt8 gadgets, Poseidon2 parameters, permutation argument, recursive verifier transcript, gate metadata, mixed point addition), analysing root causes, variants and remediations. Four High bugs (BUGFIX-001 to BUGFIX-004) were confirmed patched; the remaining Low/Informational issues were patched, mitigated or left as Won't Fix.

versions.coverage: Review of the BUGFIX-001 fix, which range-checks the three overwritten limbs via tri_xor_many; limited to the fix.
Review of the BUGFIX-002 fix, which range-checks the subtraction result with UInt32::from_variable_checked; limited to the fix.
Review of the BUGFIX-003 fix, which range-checks the subtraction result with from_variable_checked; limited to the fix. This commit is also the zksync-crypto-fork target revision named in the report.

Review of the BUGFIX-004 fix, which zeroes the round constants of the partial rounds between the full-round halves; limited to the fix. This commit is also the zksync-crypto target revision named in the report.
Analysis of BUGFIX-008 (non-canonical 64-bit decomposition in BoolsBuffer::get_bits of the recursive verifier transcript) at the zksync-crypto target revision; marked Won't Fix, no fix reviewed.
Review of the BUGFIX-009 fix setting max_constraint_degree to 2; limited to the fix.
Review of the BUGFIX-009 fix setting max_constraint_degree to 2; limited to the fix.
Review of the BUGFIX-009 fix setting max_constraint_degree to 1; limited to the fix.
Review of the BUGFIX-010 mitigation, which documents that add_mixed/sub_mixed require a valid affine point; limited to the change.
Review of the BUGFIX-007 fix raising the number of permutation argument repetitions to 3; limited to the fix.
Review of the BUGFIX-007 fix raising the challenge repetitions to 3; limited to the fix.

One Critical proof-forgery issue caused by unvalidated calldata array lengths was found in phase 1 and resolved.

reports.title: ZKsync Era CodeHawks Competitive Audit Report
reports.description: CodeHawks competitive audit (October 28 - December 2, 2024) of the ZKsync Gateway release era-contracts (L1 bridges, asset router and native token vaults, Bridgehub, chain facets, DA contracts, upgrades, L2 contracts, system contracts, bootloader and precompiles) and the zk-governance L1/L2 contracts in the Cyfrin/2024-10-zksync repository. It reports 1 High (priority operation re-execution when migrating the Era chain from Gateway back to L1), 10 Medium and 18 Low findings.

reports.title: Trust Security ZKsync Era Contracts Audit
reports.description: Trust Security audit of the ZKsync Era contracts at era-contracts commit 29f9ff4b, covering the L1 bridges, Bridgehub, StateTransitionManager, hyperchain diamond facets and upgrades, L2 bridge contracts, and the system contracts including the bootloader and precompiles. Governance contracts were out of scope; the report lists 3 Medium, 23 Low and 47 recommendations, with team responses still pending.

reports.title: ZKsync OS Audit
reports.description: OpenZeppelin three-phase engagement on ZKsync OS, the Rust state transition function (bootloader, system, system hooks, EE framework, EVM interpreter, oracle provider, runner and forward system), with two high-level assessments followed by a full audit of both scopes at a single commit. Three Critical and one High issues (sequencer DoS via unsupported EE routing, return data buffer draining, usize-dependent non-determinism, legacy transaction access list abuse) were found and resolved.

reports.title: Tooling Engagement Report for ZKsync Airbender
reports.description: Veridise tooling-based security assessment (February to April 2026) of the ZKsync Airbender RISC-V zkVM prover at commit 5ecb674, combining Picus/LLZK determinism checks of selected constraint-system circuits, fuzzing of the transpiler VM and unrolled prover stages, and targeted manual review of the full-statement verifiers. Three Critical issues (an underconstrained jump/branch/SLT circuit and two verifier-composition flaws) were fixed in pull requests #212 and #258; one Low and two Warnings were acknowledged.

reports.title: v.31 Interop Audit
reports.description: Diff audit of era-contracts from base babbed5 to head 4271d0a covering the v31 interoperability (InteropCenter/InteropHandler, ERC-7786), settlement-layer migration, base token and asset tracker changes across L1, DA and system contracts, plus a second diff to head dab8e51 covering the v31 upgrade contracts and PR #2182. It also reviewed zk-governance PRs #36 and #38, with fixes reviewed in individual era-contracts PRs and zk-governance PR #42.
